title: Sliders Special #3 Deadly Secrets Acclaim 1997 TV Series Chichester Zachary
conditionDescription: Painted cover with light wear and a small corner crease at the upper right; back cover with light edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Sliders Special #3: Deadly Secrets (March 1997), Acclaim Comics - based on the Sliders TV series. Wade faces a bitter reunion with her parents on a world where people live in space. Written by D.G. Chichester, pencils by Dean Zachary, inks by Sam De La Rosa; painted cover by Dennis Calero. Direct sales, $3.95 cover price.

Back cover: Parker Brothers RISK ad.

Condition: light wear with a small crease at the upper right corner of the front cover; light edge wear on the back (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
